derivedFrom.guidance: Record the upstream template/version/digest and selected authentication mode. Recompute digests and bump evidence normalization when reviewer, thread, or merge-state composition changes.

cursor.replay: The cursor covers PR identity, creation time, status, source commit, merge status, sorted reviewers, and sorted thread state. An unchanged cursor returns idle.

semantics.terminal: Completed or abandoned PRs return terminal. Preflight-declared terminal and a terminal transition after safe preflight but before the first attempt return eventless terminal.
semantics.duplicates: Event IDs are deterministic from PR ID and normalized cursor. Recipients must deduplicate repeated event IDs.

initialEmission.actionable: A naturally actionable attention, ready-to-merge, or completion condition emits on the first attempt even when emitInitialSnapshot and emitInitialCreatedEvent are false.
initialEmission.synthetic: Created and snapshot baseline events emit only when their corresponding parameters are true. The pinned registration keeps both false and authorizes neither kind.

semantics.diagnostics: Identity, authentication, provider, and configuration failures return schema-valid degraded results and write a structured detectorDiagnostic JSON record to stderr only.
semantics.classification: Reviewer votes at or below blockingReviewerVoteAtMost are blocking. The default is -10, so Azure DevOps vote -5 (waiting for author) is not classified as rejection.

credentials.policy: Select exactly one mode: bearer with AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN or PAT with AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT. Allowlist only the selected variable.

scheduling.maxSafeDowntimeRationale: Current reviewer votes and merge status can change between observations even though threads are durable; six recommended intervals is the conservative bound.
